description: How walls, slabs, columns, roofs and stairs (ids) show where plans and sections cut them: solid, grey, outline, or a hatch pattern: hatch, cross, brick, block, concrete, insulation, earth, stone, timber, steel, sand, or the project's own (own:<id>). pat adds patterns from an AutoCAD .pat file's text (each *NAME, description then a line per family: angle, x, y, dx, dy[, dashes], mm on paper; ;%UNITS=INCH for inches) to the project first, so pattern can name one of them. Returns the pattern set and any added.
name: set_cut_pattern
title: Set cut patterns
